verdict.rationale: Cekura stores customer call data, including transcripts and recordings, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention periods, retention settings, or deletion of stored call logs. PII redaction is an adjacent privacy control, not retention or deletion. The CLI's line about managing 'call data' does not say data can be deleted or retention configured.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
